summary: This study tested how well an oral vitamin B12 supplement works for adults with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus who have low vitamin B12 levels from taking metformin. A total of 50 participants took part in comparing the vitamin supplement to an inactive substance called a placebo. The trial was sponsored by Liaquat University of Medical & Health Sciences and is now Completed.
